profile_text.body:
XPENG INC. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou, traded under the ticker XPEV, with CIK 0001810997. Its Spanish market site presents a fully electric range under the slogan "Xpande tu mundo," and the company says it has been turning what the world calls the future into reality since 2014.

The site describes three models, the G6, G9 and P7⁺, which it says combine artificial intelligence, advanced driver assistance systems and the SEPA 2.0 800-volt electric platform, allowing a charge from 10% to 80% in 12 minutes across the range. All three carry the DGT CERO label and a warranty of up to 7 years / 160.000 km. Visitors are invited to leave their details to arrange a test drive or ask for more information.

The site names CAETANO AUTOMOTIVE ESPAÑA DISTRIBUCIÓN, S.L.U. as the party responsible for handling inquiry data, and lists financing offers provided by Open Bank, S.A. For the G6 RWD Standard Range it quotes a cash price of 41.122,71€ and a financed price of 37.522,71 € with a T.A.E. of 3,53%, and for the G9 RWD Standard Range a cash price of 56.590,30€ with a T.A.E. of 6,76%. The offers are stated as valid until 30/09/2026. No lawsuits involving the company are noted.
